title: Site Engineer
content_text: Ventia Site Engineer for Sydney Roads Asset Performance Contract (SRAPC). Permanent full-time. Graduates welcome. Bachelor of Engineering (Civil preferred). Current Drivers licence and White Card. Pavement-focused works including asphalt re-sheeting, stabilisation and concrete works. Site scoping, measurement, subcontractor coordination. Based Arndell Park with Western Sydney site visits. Night shifts about once a week.
apply_instructions: Apply via Ventia careers / listing Apply Now
